title: Comparator with Hysteresis
constraints: `VH` is a `real` parameter / generic, default `0.1` V.
Switch high only when `vp - vn > VH/2` and low only when `vp - vn < -VH/2` (strict inequalities). Otherwise hold.
There is no clock. `q` must react within 1 ns of an input change.
`q` starts at 0. The model does not need to be synthesizable.
hints: Re-evaluate whenever an input changes: `always @(vp or vn)` in SystemVerilog, `process (vp, vn)` in VHDL.
Assign `q` only in the two threshold branches. Leaving it unassigned in between gives the "hold" behavior — exactly the latch you want in a model.
Give `q` its initial value in the port declaration (`output logic q = 1'b0` / `q : out std_logic := '0'`).
